title: SoCalGas Technology Helps Customers Avoid Nearly $11 Million in Estimated Energy Costs
summary: LOS ANGELES, Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Southern California Gas Company SoCalGas , a subsidiary of Sempra NYSE, has helped customers avoid an estimated $11 million
body_markdown:
LOS ANGELES


, Nov. 20, 2026


/PRNewswire/ --[Southern California Gas Company](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4828102-1&h=2848283416&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.socalgas.com%2F&a=Southern+California+Gas+Company) (SoCalGas), a subsidiary of Sempra (NYSE: SRE), has helped customers avoid an estimated $11 million in unnecessary natural gas costs since 2019 by using advanced meter data to identify unusual energy use.


The Advanced Meter Analytics program reviews consumption patterns at approximately 195,000 facilities each year to identify unusual usage for further review. Through 2026, the program has supported follow-up reviews associated with 21,444 gas leaks and 9,809 hot water leaks, helping customers identify potential issues that could lead to unnecessary energy and water costs.


In one recent case, the program identified sustained elevated gas use associated with a hidden hot water leak beneath a home. By alerting the customer to the unusual usage, SoCalGas helped bring attention to an issue that may otherwise have gone unnoticed, allowing the customer to address the leak and avoid continued unnecessary natural gas and water use.


"Customers shouldn't have to discover an unusually high bill before realizing something may be wrong," said Gillian Wright, senior vice president and chief systems and technology officer at SoCalGas. "By using data more intelligently, we can help identify unusual energy use earlier, give customers information they can act on and help them avoid unnecessary costs."


The program evaluates metered gas-consumption patterns and flags sustained unusual usage for additional review under established screening and response criteria. An indication of unusual consumption does not by itself confirm a gas leak or unsafe condition. Depending on the circumstances, SoCalGas may contact the customer or schedule a field visit to help determine the cause and appropriate next steps.


For residential customers, follow-up may identify issues such as a hidden hot water leak or an appliance unintentionally left on. Addressing these conditions can help customers reduce unnecessary energy use and avoid unexpected costs.


These customer benefits depend on modern metering infrastructure. SoCalGas has a pending application before the California Public Utilities Commission seeking authorization to replace its current advanced metering system and continue supporting analytics capabilities that provide customer and operational benefits.


The Advanced Meter Analytics program demonstrates how SoCalGas is using technology to spot unusual energy use earlier, give customers information they can act on and help keep energy affordable by avoiding unnecessary costs.


**About SoCalGas**


SoCalGas is the largest gas distribution utility in the United States, serving more than 21 million consumers across approximately 24,000 square miles of Central and Southern California. Our mission is: *Safe, Reliable, and Affordable energy delivery today. Ready for tomorrow.* SoCalGas is a recognized leader in the energy industry and has been named Corporate Member of the Year by the Los Angeles Chamber of Commerce for its volunteer leadership in the communities it serves. SoCalGas is a subsidiary of Sempra (NYSE: SRE), a leading U.S. utility growth business.
